approaches.name: L2 norm of the difference
approaches.explanation: ‖a − b‖₂ is the default metric for k-NN and K-Means in continuous space.

editorial: Euclidean distance is the L2 norm of a − b. K-Means and k-NN use it because it matches the geometry of squared error. In high dimensions all points become far apart; that is a modeling issue, not a bug in the formula. If you only need nearest neighbors, compare squared distances and skip the square root.
